name: 2004 Calumet Avenue — Brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

function.note: The 1911 sheet marks the building 'D' (dwelling): '3B brick dwelling (D) faced in stone (blue) along its Calumet front, with a canted bay there, long on its lot, a projection on its south side'. Carried to 1904 on the T-3018 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3018, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35e trace (s35efp-calumet_2004-b1), the T-3018 census (s35e-2004-front) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35e-2004 (Brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3018).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3018 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2004 S. position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 17.250, v -2.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.611 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B with the stone face the sheet runs along its Calumet front, stood as the house's own stone front with its canted bay. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1438547783 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-background-3018.
